heading: Legal notice

sections.heading: Publisher
lines: Sylent, a natural person, publishes this site on a non-professional basis.
As article 1-1, II of the law of 21 June 2004 (LCEN) allows, the publisher doesn’t show their identity here: the host named below holds it, through the publisher’s account.
To contact the publisher: open an issue on GitHub.

sections.heading: Statistics
lines: The site counts its visits with GoatCounter, without a cookie and without storing anything in your browser: pages, source of the visit, browser, system, screen size, country. The counts are anonymous and hosted by GoatCounter. Read its privacy policy.
The site has no form and collects nothing else.
